categories.main_business_segments: Cathay Consolidated, Inc. primarily operates in the production of TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane) functional fabrics and finished components. Its main product lines serve four key sectors: outdoor products, medical products, lifesaving equipment, and military industry applications. The company also engages in international trade and other related manufacturing activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced TPU processing technologies including secondary processing (lamination, coating, embossing) and tertiary processing (cutting, high-frequency welding, sewing). It employs imported lamination equipment and integrates high-frequency and heat-press technologies to produce high-quality, lightweight, waterproof, antibacterial, flame-retardant, and high-pressure resistant TPU fabrics and components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international brand manufacturers and their OEMs in the outdoor, medical, lifesaving, and military sectors. Major end markets are high-end outdoor equipment, medical beds and cushions, inflatable lifesaving devices, and military protective gear. The company targets global markets with a focus on Europe, North America, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Yilan County. Its sales are predominantly export-oriented, with significant market presence in the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company plans to expand further into the European medical and lifesaving markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cathay Consolidated operates primarily in the midstream segment of the TPU industry, performing secondary and tertiary processing of TPU raw materials into functional fabrics and finished products. It sources raw TPU pellets and fabrics from upstream suppliers and supplies processed materials and components to downstream brand manufacturers and OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-technology TPU products, focusing on disposable medical materials, marine lifesaving fabrics, military special performance fabrics with infrared stealth capabilities, and digital printing functional fabrics. It aims to enhance production flexibility, introduce smart machinery, accelerate new product development, and align with ESG and net-zero carbon policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of TPU functional fabrics and finished components to international brand customers and OEMs. The company does not disclose subscription or licensing models, relying on manufacturing and sales contracts with major clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The TPU market is competitive with major global suppliers like BASF, Lubrizol, Covestro, Huntsman, and Wanhua Chemical. Cathay Consolidated differentiates itself through advanced lamination and processing technologies, integrated secondary and tertiary production lines, and close customer collaboration, positioning it as a specialized midstream supplier with strong R&D and production capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported net operating revenue of approximately NT$2.51 billion, a slight decrease of 2.1% from the previous year. Net profit after tax was NT$489.6 million, down 7.6%. The company maintains a stable financial structure with total assets of NT$3.59 billion and equity of NT$2.40 billion, showing steady growth and investment in production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cathay Consolidated offers high-quality, customizable TPU functional fabrics and components with superior properties such as lightweight, antibacterial, flame retardant, and high durability. Its competitive edge lies in advanced production technology, rapid response to customer needs, and the ability to develop innovative products tailored for demanding applications in outdoor, medical, lifesaving, and military markets.
